d: ABANA Enterprises Group Co. is looking for a Presales Engineer to manage the technical and commercial preparation of bids, from the initial client inquiry through to project award.

The role involves reviewing tender documents, engineering drawings, and technical specifications; developing suitable technical solutions; preparing quantity takeoffs and bills of quantities; coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors; and preparing comprehensive technical and commercial proposals in line with project requirements.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in ICT/ELV presales, estimation, or solution design.
Ability to read engineering drawings, perform quantity takeoffs, and prepare detailed BOQs independently.
Working knowledge of copper and fiber cabling, racks and pathways, and active network components such as switches, uplinks, and wireless access points.
Proficiency in Excel for estimating and costing, and ability to use AutoCAD or an equivalent tool to review drawings and extract quantities.
Strong written and verbal English skills, with the ability to prepare proposals and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams
r: li
Review RFQs, RFPs, drawings, specifications, and BOQs to identify scope gaps, quantity discrepancies, and items requiring client clarification.
li
Develop ICT and ELV solutions covering structured cabling, fiber optic networks, switching, wireless, CCTV, access control, and fire alarm systems, depending on the project scope.
li
Interpret floor plans, riser diagrams, schematics, and route drawings to prepare quantity takeoffs, material lists, and equipment schedules.
li
Coordinate site surveys with the project team and use the findings to validate quantities, installation requirements, and site constraints.
li
Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors and subcontractors. Verify technical compliance, scope coverage, lead times, warranties, and commercial terms.
li
Prepare detailed cost estimates for materials, labor, subcontracted works, testing, and commissioning. Develop pricing in line with approved margins.
li
Prepare technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, datasheets, and clear assumptions, exclusions, and qualifications.
li

Support Sales during client meetings, technical presentations, and bid clarifications. Coordinate with the project team before submission to validate delivery commitments and hand over the awarded scope, costing, and bid commitments.
